name: Focal Loss
tagline: Down-weights easy (well-classified) examples by modulating cross-entropy with a (1 - p_t)^gamma factor.
diff_from_baseline: Lin et al., ICCV 2017 (Focal Loss for Dense Object Detection). Reduces relative loss on easy examples so training focuses on hard misclassified ones; widely adopted for imbalanced classification.

name: Label Smoothing
tagline: Replaces one-hot targets with a soft mixture (1 - eps) one-hot + eps/C, preventing overconfident logits.
diff_from_baseline: Szegedy et al., CVPR 2016 (Rethinking the Inception Architecture). Standard regularizer that softens hard targets; default in many ResNet/Transformer training recipes. Implemented via PyTorch's F.cross_entropy(label_smoothing=0.1).

name: PolyLoss
tagline: Adds a first-order polynomial correction to cross-entropy: CE + epsilon * (1 - p_t).
diff_from_baseline: Leng et al., ICLR 2022 (PolyLoss: A Polynomial Expansion Perspective of Classification Loss Functions). Re-weights the leading term of the CE Taylor expansion - simple drop-in often improving generalization across CV tasks.
